name: Imatinib (CML, chronic phase, first-line)

biomarkers.note: CML is defined by the BCR::ABL1 fusion (Philadelphia chromosome); confirm Ph-positive or BCR::ABL1-positive by qPCR at diagnosis. A T315I kinase-domain mutation confers resistance to imatinib (and to dasatinib, nilotinib and bosutinib); ponatinib or asciminib is the treatment option for T315I. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Chronic Myeloid Leukemia v2.2027.

lineOfTherapy: first-line for newly diagnosed chronic-phase CML

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: BCR::ABL1-positive (Ph-positive) chronic-phase CML confirmed by qPCR
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2027, CML workup (Ph-positive or BCR::ABL1 positive by qPCR)

drugs.name: Imatinib

provenance.locator: MS-27 (recommended starting dose of imatinib is 400 mg once daily for CP-CML)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Chronic Myeloid Leukemia v2.2027, MS-27. Imatinib 400 mg PO once daily, continuous. Days 1 to 28 represents continuous daily dosing (a tyrosine kinase inhibitor is not cycled). Imatinib 800 mg is not recommended as initial therapy (MS-24 to MS-25). Continue until loss of response, progression or intolerance.

supportiveCare: Continuous daily oral therapy; adherence is critical to maintaining molecular response.
Monitor BCR::ABL1 (International Scale) by qPCR at treatment milestones to assess response and detect resistance (CML-G).
If suboptimal response or resistance, test for BCR::ABL1 kinase-domain mutations; a T315I mutation directs a switch to ponatinib or asciminib.

monitoring: CBC with differential at baseline and periodically
BCR::ABL1 (IS) by qPCR at approximately 3, 6 and 12 months and periodically thereafter (CML-G)
liver function and fluid retention/edema assessment

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 to 4 hematologic or non-hematologic toxicity
doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt and resume at a reduced dose per prescribing information; excessive reduction below 300 mg/day has been associated with inferior outcomes (MS-27). Physician decides.

guideline.locator: MS-27 (recommended starting dose of imatinib is 400 mg once daily for CP-CML); MS-24 to MS-25 (imatinib 800 mg not recommended as initial therapy); T315I/ponatinib option (manuscript and CML footnote)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for first-line imatinib in chronic-phase, BCR::ABL1-positive CML. Dose grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Chronic Myeloid Leukemia v2.2027, MS-27: imatinib 400 mg PO once daily. Modeled as continuous daily oral therapy (cycleLengthDays 28 for reporting, cycles null, days 1 to 28 = continuous) because a tyrosine kinase inhibitor is taken continuously, not in discrete cycles. BCR::ABL1 is the diagnostic and monitoring biomarker; a T315I mutation directs ponatinib or asciminib. histology and treatmentIntent are VERIFY (not established as curative versus palliative by the source). Core textbook cross-reference is pending; grounding is guideline-layer only. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
